cve_summary: The devzvol_readdir function in illumos does not check the return value of a strchr call, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (NULL pointer dereference and panic) via unspecified vectors.
commit_message:
5421 devzvol_readdir() needs to be more careful with strchr
Reviewed by: Keith Wesolowski <keith.wesolowski@joyent.com>
Reviewed by: Jerry Jelinek <jerry.jelinek@joyent.com>
Approved by: Dan McDonald <danmcd@omniti.com>
docstring:
/******************************************************************************  
 * Summary:  
 * This function implements the readdir operation for a device volume,  
 * allowing directory entries to be read from a specified vnode.  
 *  
 * Parameters:  
 * dvp (struct vnode *): The vnode representing the directory to read from.  
 * uiop (struct uio *): The user I/O structure for reading data.  
 * cred (struct cred *): The credentials of the user requesting the read.  
 * eofp (int *): Pointer to an integer indicating end-of-file status.  
 * ct_unused (caller_context_t *): Unused context parameter.  
 * flags_unused (int): Unused flags parameter.  
 *  
 * Returns:  
 * int: Returns 0 on success, or an error code on failure.  
 *  
 * Logic:  
 * The function checks the path of the device node and handles special cases  
 * for the ZVOL_DIR, creating necessary directories if needed, and iterates  
 * over datasets to populate the directory entries. It manages read/write  
 * locks to ensure thread safety during directory operations.  
 ******************************************************************************/
